repo_notes.content: Browser-only Battleship (human vs AI) in TypeScript + Vite. Game rules live in src/game (pure, no DOM), UI in src/ui/app.ts. Write for beginners; the UI and docs are in Japanese.

pages.title: ゲームの全体像
pages.purpose: What the game does, how to play, and how the src/game and src/ui layers fit together

pages.title: ゲームのルール処理（Board と Game）
pages.purpose: Explain src/game/board.ts and src/game/game.ts: ship placement, attack results, sinking, turns and winner

pages.title: AIの考え方
pages.purpose: Explain the hunt-and-target strategy in src/game/ai.ts and why it never repeats a cell

pages.title: 画面（UI）
pages.purpose: Explain src/ui/app.ts: rendering, click handling, AI turn timer and restart

pages.title: テストと公開
pages.purpose: Explain the Vitest tests in tests/, the CI workflow and the GitHub Pages deploy workflow
